name: singlet_ingest_quant_read_to_gene_mapping
title: Read-to-gene mapping engine
description: Maps the cDNA reads of one single-cell or single-nucleus library to genes with a chosen engine (alevin_fry by default; starsolo or kb_kallisto_bustools; cellranger_import only imports an existing Cell Ranger matrix) and writes an unfiltered barcode-by-gene UMI matrix to layers/counts with mapping diagnostics and a run record. It needs the parse stream after barcode correction, both FASTQ files and a reference index from ingest-quant.reference_annotation_build; pass reference_type splici_intronic for nuclei and a multi_gene_policy the mapper supports. Use dry_run first. Do not use it to call cells, remove ambient RNA or doublets, or re-resolve an existing matrix (use the multi-gene assignment task).

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

inputs.description: Files and library properties the engine reads. Not .singlet members.

parse_stream.description: Parse stream after whitelist correction: read_id, corrected barcode, UMI, cdna_read_id, parse status. Path or URI.

fastq_r1.description: R1 FASTQ holding the cell barcode and UMI. Path or URI.

fastq_r2.description: R2 FASTQ holding the cDNA. Path or URI.

reference_index.description: Genome directory, kallisto index, Salmon index or splici FASTA from reference_annotation_build; must match reference_type and mapper.

reference_type.description: Sequence set the reads are mapped against. Use splici_intronic for nuclei; starsolo uses genome_gtf.

strandedness.description: Read orientation relative to transcripts. Sent explicitly to every engine and recorded.

imported_matrix.description: Only for cellranger_import: path to a Cell Ranger raw_feature_bc_matrix directory, used instead of the FASTQ files.

mapper.description: Engine. cellranger_import maps nothing: it reads a matrix produced by the user's own licensed Cell Ranger installation.

multi_gene_policy.description: Multi-gene resolution. starsolo: discard, uniform, prop_unique, rescue, em. kb: discard, em. alevin_fry: cr_like*, trivial, parsimony*, singlet_em. Invalid pairs are rejected.

threads.description: Worker threads for the engine stages.

alevin_fry.description: Options used only when mapper is alevin_fry.

mapping_mode.description: Salmon mapping stage: selective alignment, or sketch (pseudoalignment without per-placement scores).

small_thresh.description: Cells with fewer reads use cr-like semantics whatever the policy; 0 resolves every cell with the requested policy. Engine default 100.

umi_edit_distance.description: Hamming radius for merging UMIs; null uses the engine default (0 for cr_like*, trivial; 1 for parsimony*).

large_graph_thresh.description: Parsimony graph order above which a faster strategy applies; parsimony policies only.

starsolo.description: Options used only when mapper is starsolo.

features.description: soloFeatures: Gene counts reads matching transcripts; GeneFull variants also count intronic reads (pre-mRNA).

cell_filter.description: soloCellFilter string. None writes the matrix without engine cell filtering; engine default is CellRanger2.2 3000 0.99 10.

max_multimap.description: outFilterMultimapNmax: maximum loci a read may map to before it is treated as unmapped.

kb_kallisto_bustools.description: Options used only when mapper is kb_kallisto_bustools.

union.description: Use the union instead of the intersection of k-mer target sets in pseudoalignment.

em.description: Options for EM policies (em, cr_like_em, parsimony_em, singlet_em).

bootstraps.description: Bootstrap replicates of the class counts for per-gene uncertainty; 0 disables. Not valid for starsolo or kb.

seed.description: Random seed for bootstrap resampling in singlet_em.

max_iterations.description: Maximum EM iterations for singlet_em (proposed default).

tolerance.description: Relative change of the log-likelihood below which singlet_em stops (proposed default).

device.description: Execution device for singlet_em and bootstrap; engine stages run on the CPU. auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory exists.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. layers/counts. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: mapper, mapper_version, reference_type, reference_hash, multi_gene_policy, barcodes_with_umi, genes_detected, median_mapped_fraction, median_multigene_umi_fraction, em_converged, wall_clock_s, peak_rss_gb. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
